w: In the evening, Swamishri blessed the volunteer's assembly.
Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha rituals of murtis to be installed in the newly built Swaminarayan Mandir in Bharkunda (taluka: Kathlal).
One who has imbibed character then his wealth brings him happiness.
To purify one's mind one needs to offer devotion to God, read scriptures and keep the company of good people.
There is no value in decorating oneself; value lies in having character.

The previous day a yagna of 51 kunds was held as part of the murti pratishtha rituals in Umreth. 350 participants participated in the yagna. The same day in the evening a grand procession of murtis was carried out by 7,000 devotees and well-wishers.

Swamishri performed murti-pratishtha rituals of Dham, Dhami and Mukta, Laxmi Narayan Dev and Guru Parampara. Thereafter an assembly was held in which 9,000 devotees were present. Swamishri blessed the assembly.

Swamishri departed from Umreth and reached Dakor at 1.15 p.m. In the evening Swamishri went for darshan of the holy places in Dakor, namely, Gomti pond, Danknath Mahadev (where Bhakta Bodana had brought the murti of Ranchhodrayji from Dwarika and placed it there) and Ranchhodrayji mandir where he was honored and welcomed by the trustees.
Swamishri blessed the evening satsang assembly in Dakor.
After dinner Swamishri met the mahants of different mandirs in Dakor.

From 11.20 am to 12.35 pm the Station Director of Akash Vani, Amdavad, Tusharbhai Shukla, and senior officer, Bhanubhai, and renowned writer, Raghuvir Chaudhari, arrived to take an interview of Swamishri. For the archival records of Akash Vani the officials desired to capture Swamishri’s voice and message. Like the messages of Mahatma Gandhi, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, Jawaharlal Nehru, Subhashchandra Bose, Swamishri’s message would be of great value to the country. A radio talk was arranged wherein Swamishri, Viveksagar Swami, Aksharvatsal Swami, Raghuvirbhai Chaudhari, Tusharbhai Shukla and Bhanubhai participated. Questions posed to Swamishri were about how he renounced home to become a sadhu at the hands of Shastriji Maharaj and his appointment as the president of BAPS by Shastriji Maharaj. Viveksagar Swami described the unremitting efforts of Swamishri’s home-visits and vicharan for the growth of the Satsang fellowship. Aksharvatsal Swami described the socio-spiritual activities inspired by Swamishri. Swamishri also advised on how to create family harmony and solidarity. The entire one-and-a-half hour recording was relayed in half hour slots on radio throughout Gujarat on 12, 19 and 26 December 2004.

Shri Madhur Bajaj of Bajaj Automobiles met Swamishri after seeing Akshardham complex. He praised, “You have done a wonderful thing. When one comes to swarg there is no limitation of time. Because of your presence I get a lot of positive vibrations. People forget their problems and forget where they are. After seeing this I felt that there is everything in India. There is no need to go anywhere else. Such a place will keep our culture alive. Children will get the impressions of our culture. I have also experienced that when ordinary people do something with thought and unity they can do extraordinary work…”

Today, after the midday meal, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was going to his room bowing to everyone, Gunmanandas Swami stretched out his hand before him. Swamishri took hold of his hand. Seeing this, the sadhu prayed, "Do not forget us."
"We are not going to leave anyone," Swamishri said.
Hearing this, everyone exclaimed, "Do not forget those you have loved; O lover of devotees, you are the most loving..."

Today during the night assembly, when Harikrishna Maharaj left to take his meal, Mahant Swami Maharaj immediately asked for Thakorji (the trimurti, Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj). So there was even a discussion among the sadhus: "In no assembly until now has Swamishri asked for Thakorji like this after Harikrishna Maharaj has left, so why did Swamishri ask for Thakorji today?"

No one found a satisfactory answer. So after the cheshta singing the attendants asked Swamishri himself, "Swami! You never did before, so why did you ask for Thakorji today? Because the annakut was being offered?"
Swamishri said, "No. Everywhere else, Thakorji and Bapa (Pramukh Swami Maharaj) are behind, above or around. Here they were not."
What wonderful supreme devotion!! No one had even noticed this or thought of it.
Such supreme devotion is not born of thoughts or experiences. It is born from the heart.
